# yml

The file `_quarto.yml` determines the overall structure of the quarto website.
It includes various segments.

## Segments

- [Project](/yml/project_n_misc.qmd): Determines what kind of project you create
    - This website focusses on creating a website project but you can also create books, manuscripts, and presentations with quarto
- [Website](/yml/website.qmd): General website and options and the structure of the website

## Indentation

One note is that indentation is vital in the file.
Everything must be indented to to correct amount or creating the site will fail.

An example can be see in the following link containing the `_quarto.yml` file for this website.

[The websites _quarto.yml on github](https://github.com/m-gemmell/Quarto_guide/blob/main/_quarto.yml)
